text:
Maya: noticed a sudden spike in 5xx from hosted-api around 09:12 UTC, customer tickets piling up :face_with_thermometer:
Ian: seeing the same in prod metrics - 503s from api-gateway, traffic looks normal but error rate jumped to ~8% for a slice
Priya: any deploys/flags around that time? checking deploy-bot logs
deploy-bot: deployment started by carlos @1768422100 - service: api-router, image: api-router:v2026.03.17-5b2
Carlos: rolled a canary for kernel-routing change + new kv-prefetch flag
Sam: support queue has a handful of customers reporting `502` -> `503` gateway errors with small payloads, includes repro snippets
Maya: can anyone repro locally against canary? add steps here
Ian: repro on staging with the canary tag: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://staging.api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> returns `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable` and logs `runtime:prefetch: handler panic: invalid auth header` in canary pod logs
Priya: logs show `panic: unexpected header len` in `authz` module after kernel-routing switch, looks like header normalization path hit incompatible code
Carlos: ooof — that new kernel selector was supposed to be opt-in, but the routing flag scope got applied cluster-wide for the slice due to selector tag mismatch
Sam: customers impacted include a midmarket account on dedicated tier; they've opened urgent billing+availability tickets
support-bot: created incident INC-2026-042 - escalated to SRE and Eng; paging oncall
Maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) remove canary weight 2) if errors persist, rollback to previous image 3) add temporary traffic pin for affected tenants
Ian: removing canary weight now: `kubectl patch svc api-router --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"canaryWeight":0}}' -n prod` — watch metrics
Priya: rolling back canary pods to prev revision in progress: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-router -n prod` — applying
Carlos: confirm the flag that leaked: `routing.kernel_selector=kernel-v2` was set in ops-config with selector `env:canary` but label mismatch caused it to apply to `slice=gold` as well
Sam: prepping communication for affected customers, need ETA for rollback completion
Maya: telemetry shows drop in 5xx after rollback start but still elevated for a few instances - looks like some cached routing metadata persisted in frontends
Ian: discovered stale prefix in edge shard causing continued routing to kernel-v2; flushing cache on shard-4
Priya: cache flush command: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api.internal/flush?shard=4 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>'` - executed
Carlos: after cache flush, error rate back down to baseline ~0.3% :thumbsup:
Sam: confirming with customer #4572, they see successful calls again
Maya: postmortem checklist items: 1) add stricter selector validation in flag rollout tooling 2) prevent global scope by default 3) improve canary gating so kernel-selector changes require a manual confirm 4) add automated rollback if 5xx > 3% for 5m
Ian: for next immediate step, adding a quick telemetry alarm for `authz` panics: `alert if sum(authz.panic_count{env=prod}) by (slice) > 0 for 1m`
Priya: also adding a short-term mitigation: if `routing.kernel_selector` differs from `legacy` for a tenant, pin their traffic to legacy until manual review
Carlos: filing a follow-up RFC to change the deploy tooling to require explicit `--apply-to` flags
support-bot: updated incident INC-2026-042 with remediation notes and customer messages
Sam: will send customer status update now (ETA ~15m, resolved)
Maya: capturing repro steps and logs in the runbook: copy of relevant logs:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:09Z api-router[pod-abc123]: runtime:prefetch: handler panic: invalid auth header
2026-03-17T09:12:09Z authz[service]: panic: unexpected header len, header=0x0
2026-03-17T09:12:10Z kernel-selector: matched kernel-v2 for tenant=gold slice=gold
```
Maya: timeline and owner notes in INC ticket. kudos to team for quick rollback. closing once SLA confirmations from customers are in
Sam: marking as handoff to postmortem owner @Priya
Priya: will own the postmortem and follow-ups, adding action items to backlog
Maya: any remaining open tasks? otherwise I'll close this thread in 30m
Ian: monitoring for 15m more, all good so far
Carlos: adding a small test harness to CI to catch header normalization mismatches before deploy
support-bot: incident INC-2026-042 status: mitigated (awaiting customer ack)
